impedance.terminal_mask_interpretation: Mask1 rows train that critic; mask0 rows are intentionally withheld from its loss. Report fitting and held-out prediction separately; aggregate error mixes them.
impedance.terminal_error_limitation: Critic includes remaining time and causal history; actor directly receives neither feature. It is a diagnostic, not a required zero-error convergence gate.
impedance.soft_bound_limitation: Necessary bound for frozen checkpoint policy/current alpha and spt_v1; not a future changing-alpha bound, and satisfying it does not establish calibration.
impedance.td_diagnostic_pair: critics0/1 fixed diagnostic; CHEQ training samples critic pairs
